query: Do you have experience with naming work for major financial institutions? We may need to rename part of our business as part of the reorganization.

props.title: Naming a Part of Your Business Through a Reorganization
props.subtitle: Renaming within a financial institution
props.challengeSummary: You're asking about naming support as part of a reorganization, where part of your business may need a new name.

props.title: Name the System, Not Just the Unit
props.content: Our approach would be to treat a rename as a nomenclature decision. A name has to sit alongside your existing names, hold up across markets, and clear availability checks before it earns a place in the structure.

props.title: J.P. Morgan: Naming the Future of Retail Payments Hardware
props.summary: We built the naming and nomenclature strategy, generated name candidates and ran availability assessments for J.P. Morgan's new payments hardware terminals. The names Paypin and Paypad were launched by the company at one of the world's largest retail expos.

final.explanation: Our J.P. Morgan work is the naming we've published for a major financial institution, and it covered a product line rather than a business unit. For your rename, we'd start by agreeing what the new unit must signal and who has to sign off, because reorganization names tend to stall on alignment before creativity. We haven't published a business-unit rename, so our Strategy Lead can scope that with you.
